generate_llvm_action_genfiles: generate C++ action space files from a CSV list of LLVM passes piped to stdin
run_make_action_sources: run make_action_sources to generate ActionEnum.h, ActionSwitch.h, and ActionHeaders.h from a pass iterator
process_single_pass: process a single LLVM pass to extract its header, enum name, and switch case entry
generate_pass_flags: generate flags.txt and flag_descriptions.txt listing all pass flags and descriptions from a pass list
run_main_entry: run the main entry point with an output directory argument and CSV pass list on stdin
